response.justification: The candidate possesses a strong and highly relevant background in the geospatial domain, having founded a Geo-Data platform and worked on GIS applications. His experience at Dunnhumby building low-latency, high-performance systems with Dlang demonstrates capability in a similar problem space. However, he critically lacks the primary required skill of recent, professional experience in modern C++ or Rust. His C++ experience is nearly a decade old, posing a significant risk and potential ramp-up time. An interview is recommended to gauge his C++ knowledge and his ability to quickly adapt to the required tech stack.
strengths: Extensive, hands-on experience building geospatial data platforms (GISCollective).
Proven ability to develop low-latency, high-performance distributed systems.
Broad engineering background with a history of adapting to new languages and technologies.
concerns: No professional experience with modern C++ or Rust; C++ experience is very dated (2015).
Extensive use of Dlang, which is not a specified language for the role.
Geospatial experience seems focused on data collection/platforms, not specifically on routing or tile optimization.
